title: Max width is overstated
text: Max width is overstated. Would not hold the shower curtain at the max advertised width. Add some spacers to reduce width by about 6 inches, and now it works fine. But it will not tighten as much as I would like

product_metadata.title: Amazer Spring Tension Curtain Rod - 54-90 Inches Rust-Resistance Shower Curtain Rod Bathroom Rod, Bronze
features: Adjustable length of 54 inches-90 inches easily fit most shower stalls
Inside and outside tube diameter: 0.75 inches / 0.87 inches. The end of the shower curtain rod is detachable, you can match the hooks and shower curtains you want
Bronze shower rod finish is durable and chip-resistant
Easy-to-install tension mounting. No cutting, drilling or tools necessary to install rod
Apply for all surface,include both of smooth and rough surface like wallpaper wall,tile wall,wooden frame, etc. Blends with bathroom decor and hardware
